card.name: Partway through numbers and names
card.fires_on: Marks the middle of a number or coined word, such as the digit after a dash or the space before a strength figure like 11 or 400 mg. It appears most in dose, tablet and radiation-dose text, plus a few partial word breaks.

modes.label: Inside dose numbers
modes.description: A digit, decimal point or space inside a dose or strength figure.

modes.label: Space before a strength
modes.description: A space between a count word and a tablet strength.

modes.label: Inside rare names
modes.description: Partway through an unusual species or compound word.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of numbers, such as dose ranges and tablet strengths, where more digits are expected.
